LESSON: EID

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Eid

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Eid. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:
